sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Implements automated tools and processes to monitor compliance with security policies and regulations. Includes dashboards, alerts, and reporting mechanisms. Covers internal standards and external frameworks. Supports real-time visibility and audit readiness. Integrated with governance and risk management systems.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Reduces risk of non-compliance and penalties. Enhances transparency and accountability. Supports proactive remediation and governance. Builds trust with regulators and stakeholders. Enables scalable and sustainable compliance.
